verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that developer.nvidia.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a description of the NVIDIA developer portal, showing an agent-oriented docs entry point exists for NVIDIA's ecosystem (which includes H200 resources). However, the equivalent markdown docs and OpenAPI endpoints return 404s, and there is no H200-specific llms.txt or dedicated agent-oriented documentation for this GPU model. Missing for 10: H200-specific agent-readable docs, working docs.md/OpenAPI endpoints, and independent confirmation agents actually use this llms.txt for GPU-related queries.
